summary.units: fractions of trials (0-1); differences in fractions (0.15 = 15 points)

settings.matcher_per_trial: share of the five seeds (0-4) of the chosen configuration that answered correctly
settings.lora4: four-epoch runs 3-7, 64-frame walk, share correct (results/retrieval_baselines.json trials)
settings.best_rule: experiment 20's best rule of the group (procedural: combined logistic regression; photoreal: window maximum, DINOv2 CLS, all 256, k 32)
settings.lora4_shuffled: four-epoch runs 3-7 with the walk shuffled (real frame numbers kept)
settings.ordered_permuted: the ordered matcher with the frame numbers permuted at random among the shown frames (seeded per trial); its counterpart of the shuffled walk
settings.bootstrap: 10000 resamples over scenes, seed 0; one-scene groups resample trials
settings.decision: D = mean over P5000-P5009 of (LoRA four-epoch mean - matcher), novel trials: <= 0.05 suffices, >= 0.15 falls short, else partial
